summary: `make run` used -display none, so there was no input surface for the emulated PS/2 keyboard and the user could not type into the shell; a run-gui target was added.
evidence: Root cause: `make run` uses `-display none`, so there's no window at all — no window means no input surface for the emulated PS/2 keyboard.

summary: AS parser evaluated `$` as ctx->org_valid_offset instead of the current section offset.
AS encoder checked operand b instead of a for the `rep stosb` form (wrong operand slot).
evidence: the `rep stosb` check reads the wrong operand slot.

summary: AS eval_primary folded already-defined labels to their raw section offset at parse time, bypassing ORG adjustment and relocation emission.
evidence: `eval_primary` was resolving backward-referenced labels straight to their raw section offset, bypassing the org-adjustment / relocation logic in `stmt_encode` entirely.

summary: AS ELF output left REL relocation addends as 0 instead of baking them into the relocated bytes (abs32 and pc32 with -4 addend).
evidence: for x86 ELF `REL` relocations (implicit addend), the addend must be baked into the actual bytes, not left as 0.

summary: AS elf_writer had an unused-but-set variable shidx_rel causing a -Wextra warning; first fix left a remaining use.
evidence: elf_writer.c:81:9: warning: variable ‘shidx_rel’ set but not used [-Wunused-but-set-variable]

summary: AS did not handle a bare-constant jump target with no symbol (`jmp KERNEL_LOAD_ADDR`), failing stage2.S with an empty undefined symbol.
AS resolve_pcrel's next_ip (address after the relative field) was not ORG-adjusted in -f bin mode while the target was, corrupting every relative jump/call.
evidence: `resolve_pcrel`'s `next_ip` parameter wasn't org-adjusted for `-f bin` mode while the resolved target was, corrupting every relative jump/call offset in bin mode.

summary: AS resolved EQUs eagerly at parse time, so forward-referenced CODE_SEG in the far jmp became segment 0, triple-faulting stage2 on mode switch.
evidence: `CODE_SEG` (an `EQU`) is used in `jmp CODE_SEG:protected_mode_entry` at the *top* of the file, but not defined until later ... the far-jump's segment silently became 0.

summary: AS parser only accepted size keywords before a memory operand, so `push dword 0` (size hint on an immediate) in idt_stubs.S failed.
evidence: `push dword 0` uses `dword` as an immediate-size hint, not before a memory operand — my parser only handled the `[...]` case.

summary: AS used strncpy(..., MAX_NAME-1) without guaranteed termination, triggering -Wstringop-truncation warnings at -O2; replaced with safe_strcpy.
evidence: warning: ‘__builtin_strncpy’ output may be truncated copying 63 bytes from a string of length 511 [-Wstringop-truncation]

summary: AS qualify_local used snprintf into a fixed buffer, triggering a -Wformat-truncation warning at -O2; rewritten as a manual bounded copy.
